snippet.title: Bunny Forest Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the game Bunny Forest. 

Bunny Forest is a calm and cute pixel game about bunnies. Hop around, search for carrots, plant flowers, trade and explore the forest.

Available for Windows, Mac, Linux and Android on Itch: https://erytau.itch.io/bunny-forest

Also available for Android on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.erytau.bunnyforest
